language_task: Pick up the spoon and place it into the box.
outcome_evidence: The spoon initially lies beside the blue box (frame 0, ceiling). The robot closes its gripper around the spoon and lifts it from the table (frames 51–64, wrist_right and wrist_left), carries it over the box, and releases it inside (frames 80–89, wrist_right). The spoon remains in the box after the gripper withdraws (frames 104–109, ceiling). No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visibly established.
